items.title: Trump Administration Rescinds Biden-Era SBOM Guidance
items.description: Federal agencies will no longer be required to solicit software bills of material (SBOMs) from tech vendors, nor attestations that they comply with NIST's Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF). What that means long term is unclear.

items.title: Hugging Face abused to spread thousands of Android malware variants
items.description: A new Android malware campaign is using the Hugging Face platform as a repository for thousands of variations of an APK payload that collects credentials for popular financial and payment services. [...]

items.description: Ivanti has disclosed two critical vulnerabilities in Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM), tracked as CVE-2026-1281 and CVE-2026-1340, that were exploited in zero-day attacks. [...]

items.title: More Critical Flaws on n8n Could Compromise Customer Security
items.description: A new around of vulnerabilities in the popular AI automation platform could let attackers hijack servers and steal credentials.

items.title: Google disrupts IPIDEA residential proxy networks fueled by malware

items.title: Exposed Open Directory Leaks BYOB Framework Across Windows, Linux, and macOS
items.description: Threat researchers have uncovered an actively serving command and control server hosting a complete deployment of the BYOB framework following the discovery of an exposed open directory.
